account_audit_notes: No local API keys or tokens present in environment or filesystem. Requires user authentication via 'lightning login' or web portal before cloud jobs can be dispatched.

platform_specifications.free_tier_model: New registered accounts receive 15 to 30 free Studio credits ($1.00 per credit equivalent).
platform_specifications.credit_billing_granularity: Per-second execution billing deduced from compute rate.
platform_specifications.persistent_storage_quota: 10 GB free persistent storage included per Studio workspace (/teamspace/studios/this_studio/).
platform_specifications.excess_storage_billing: $0.10 per GB per month ($0.00014/GB/hour) charged against credit balance.
platform_specifications.idle_auto_shutdown: Configurable idle sleep from 15 to 60 minutes (default 15-30 min) to prevent credit exhaustion.

persistence_semantics.external_storage_mounts: Supports AWS S3, Cloudflare R2, Google Cloud Storage, or Lightning Data streaming.
